title: Absolute tank with futuristic tech!
review_text: I have driven my Tata Nexon Fearless Plus for 8,500 km. The 5-star crash safety and high bonnet give immense confidence on Indian highways. The ventilated seats are a lifesaver in Delhi summers.

title: Best long-distance cruiser under 30 Lakhs
review_text: Took the XUV700 AX7L AWD on a 2,500 km road trip through Rajasthan. The diesel engine has torque for days, ADAS worked like magic on the expressway, and the Sony audio system is pure concert hall quality.

title: Super refined and comfortable city family SUV
review_text: The Hyundai Creta automatic is effortless in Bangalore traffic. The panoramic roof makes the cabin feel twice as spacious. Mileage in bumper-to-bumper traffic is around 11 kmpl, but goes up to 17 kmpl on highway stretches.
